**Economist, Inter-American Development Bank**

I am an economist working on long-run economic development, infrastructure, energy, and environmental economics, with a particular focus on Latin America.

I am an economics consultant in the Knowledge Team of the Infrastructure and Energy Sector (INE) at the Inter-American Development Bank. I hold a PhD in Economics from Brown University, and an MA and BA in Economics from Universidad de Chile.
